lies.speaker: Ezra
lies.said: Good morning, all. Ezra here, innkeeper. I keep a ledger of every rumour that passes through my doors, so I'll be listening closely. Vera, your questions are fair, but Cyrus has the watch and deserves a chance to answer in his own time. Bram, you've been quiet. What has the sea told you? I'd rather judge folk by who helps the town than by who interrogates it loudest.
